verses.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.sm: Eliu Ona le toe tali mai ai lea o ia tagata e toatolu ia Iopu, aua ua amiotonu o ia i lona lava manatu.

verses.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.sm: Ona tupu ai lea o le ita o Eliu le atalii o Parakelu, c lo sa Pusa o so le aiga o Rama, na tupu lona ita ia Topu, ina ua ta‘uamiotonuina e ia o ia, a e le o le Atua.

verses.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.sm: Ua tupu foi lona ita i ana uo e toatolu, ina ua latou le mautali, a ua latou faasala pea ia Iopu.

verses.en: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
verses.sm: Ua faatalitali Eliu ia Iopu, seia uma atu upu, aua ua toeaina i latou, a e itiiti o ia.

verses.en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
verses.sm: Ua vaai atu Eliu, ua leai se tali i fofoga o ia tagata e toatolu, ona tupu ai lea o lona ita.

verses.en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o Eliu le atalii o Parakelu, o lo sa Pusa, ua faapea mai, Ou te itiiti aʻu, a e toeaina lava outou, o le mea lea sa ou mataʻu ai, ma ou fefe e faailoa atu ia te outou laʻu taofi.

verses.en: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.sm: Sa ou faapea, Ta tautala mai aso, ia faailoa mai le poto e le tele o tausaga.

verses.en: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verses.sm: A e peitai o i ai lava le agaga i totonu o le tagata; o le mānava foi a Le e ona le malosi uma lava e faapopotoina ai i latou.

verses.en: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
verses.sm: E le laupopoto e ua sili; e le lausilafia foi le tonu e toeaina.

verses.en: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te fai atu ai, Faafofoga mai ia ia te au, ou te faaali atu foi e aʻu laʻu taofi.

verses.en: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ou faatalitali i a outou fetalaiga; ua ou faalogologo atu i o outou mafaufauga, seia filifili ni a outou fetalaiga.

verses.en: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
verses.sm: Ua ou mafaufau foi i a outou upu; faauta foi, e leai so outou ua na aoai tonu ia Iopu, po ua tali atu i ana upu.

verses.en: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
verses.sm: Me“ outou fai ane, Ua maua e i matou le poto; ua faiaina © la i le Atua lava, a e le o tagata.

verses.en: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.sm: Ua ia le sauni ana upu ia te au, Ou te le tali atu foi ia te ia i a outou upu.

verses.en: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
verses.sm: Ua fememeai i latou; ua le toe tali mai; ua latou tuu a latou fetalaiga.

verses.en: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
verses.sm: Ua ou faatalitali foi ina ua latou le tautala; a ua faalologo i latou, ua latou le toe tali mai.

verses.en: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.sm: O aʻu foi ou te tali atu lava aʻu, o aʻu lava; ou te faaali atu laʻu taofi.

verses.en: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.sm: Aua ua tumu aʻu i upu, ua uunai mai ia te au le agaga o i totonu ia te au.

verses.en: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
verses.sm: Faauta, o loʻu loto ua pei o le uaina e lei tālaina, ua tāli pa e pei o fagu pa'u fou.

verses.en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
verses.sm: Ou te tautala atu, ia ou mānava ai, ou te faamaga oʻu laugutu, ma ou tali atu ai.

verses.en: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
verses.sm: Aua lava neʻi ou faailogaina se tagata; aua foi ne‘i ou faaneenee i se tagata.

verses.en: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
verses.sm: Aua ou te le mafai ona faaneenee atu, neʻi avea. faafuasei aʻu e Le na faia a‘u. O upu a
